closePositionForSession(uint256,uint256).details: M-8: the check used to be only `pos.owner == s.user`, so an agent      granted a small budgeted session could force-close every unrelated      position the user had ever opened — realizing their losses at a      moment of the agent's choosing. The margin caps bound what an agent      can risk; they say nothing about what it can destroy. A session may      now only unwind its own trades.

createSessionWithAssets(address,uint256,.details: Pass an empty array for an unrestricted session (identical to      createSession). The three existing caps bound how much an agent can      lose; this bounds what it can lose it on — a budgeted agent could      otherwise put the whole allowance into an asset the user never      intended to hold.

setSessionAssets(uint256,bytes32[]).details: Only the user, never the agent — an agent that could widen its own      permissions would make the list decorative. Passing an empty array      clears the restriction.

allowedAssetCount(uint256).notice: How many assets a session has allow-listed. 0 = unrestricted.

allowedAssets(uint256).notice: The assets a session has allow-listed (empty = unrestricted).

closePositionForSession(uint256,uint256).notice: Agent closes a position THIS session opened.

createSession(address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: User delegates a bounded session to `agent`.

createSessionWithAssets(address,uint256,.notice: Same as createSession, but restricts the agent to `allowedAssets`.

isAssetAllowed(uint256,bytes32).notice: Whether `asset` may be traded by `sessionId`.         True for every asset when the session has no allow-list.

openPositionForSession(uint256,bytes32,b.notice: Agent opens a position for the session's user, within session limits.

revokeSession(uint256).notice: User revokes their session at any time.

sessionOfPosition(uint256).notice: The session that opened `positionId`, or type(uint256).max if none.

setSessionAssets(uint256,bytes32[]).notice: Session owner sets or replaces the allow-list.
